blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Obed Mukaba gave full justice to the “blocker” in middle blocker during the National University-Archipelago Builders’ perfect week in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference. With the Bulldogs usually drawing much of their offense from the wings, Mukaba made a huge impact at the net, piling up blocks and timely points to anchor unbeaten NU’s three-game winning streak from October 20 to 25 on his way to Spikers’ Turf Press Corps Player of the Week honors. Mukaba opened the week with 17 points, including eight blocks, in the reigning UAAP champion’s four-set win over VNS Always Bright Laticrete, […]...
